items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: she took me to see Padereski

ctx.x: The National Black Negro Opera. No, the National Negro Opera Company.

Something like that. And anyway, every once in a while she would take me to something that seemed to have made a difference, like for instance she took me to see Padereski. Padereski was appearing at Madison Square Garden at some point, I guess maybe early '30s.
